mlm:name: AIE-SEG
description: AIE-SEG is a large vision segmentation model for remote sensing imagery, deployed on the AI Earth cloud platform. It supports interactive annotation via text, point, or bounding box prompts, enabling batch segmentation and zero-shot extraction of objects across multiple images. The model is trained on tens of millions of remote sensing images with 1.3 billion labels, covering nearly a hundred semantic categories.
pretext_training_type: Vision-language pretraining with interactive prompts (points, boxes, text)
pretraining: Fine-tuned from SEEM using proprietary remote sensing training data (tens of millions of images, 1.3 billion labels, nearly 100 semantic categories)
backbone_modifications: Adapted SEEM for remote sensing imagery
Supports batch segmentation across multiple images

mlm:input.name: Landsat-5, Landsat-7, Landsat-8, Landsat-9, Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Sentinel-5P, MODIS

mlm:pretrained_source: Proprietary remote sensing dataset (tens of millions of images, 1.3 billion labels)

benchmarks.application: Arbitrary target extraction, land cover classification, binary and multi-class change detection
benchmarks.dataset: Proprietary remote sensing dataset (tens of millions of images, 1.3 billion labels)
